headline: Apar Industries shares rise 5% following a strong Q2 profit and EBITDA beat
hook: Profit and margins beat analyst expectations
summary: Apar Industries reported its second-quarter earnings, showing an EBITDA of ₹720 crore, which surpassed estimates of ₹600 crore and rose 47.5% year-on-year from ₹488 crore. Operating margins expanded by 190 basis points during the quarter. This performance drove the company's shares up by 5% on the markets. Indian retail investors tracking manufacturing and industrial stocks should note the stronger-than-expected profitability expansion.
why_it_matters: Stronger operating margins boost near-term sentiment for Apar Industries shareholders
winners_losers: Apar Industries shareholders gain / competitors face pressure
